services.title: Drain Cleaning
services.text: Clogs and blockages cleared from kitchen, bath and main lines, so wastewater flows again.

services.title: Hydro Jetting
services.text: High-pressure water scours stubborn buildup out of the line, using nothing but water.

services.title: Sewer Line Services
services.text: Sewer cleaning and repair that starts with a camera inspection of the whole run.

services.title: Under Slab Plumbing
services.text: Slab leaks found early and repaired with as little cutting into the foundation as possible.

services.title: Water Heater Services
services.text: Leaks, heating faults and system failures diagnosed, then the unit repaired or replaced.

services.title: Tankless Water Heaters
services.text: Tankless units installed, repaired and serviced, for hot water without the tank.

services.title: Gas Line Services
services.text: Installation, repair, replacement, leak detection and inspection for your gas lines.

services.title: Home Repiping
services.text: Aging or damaged pipe replaced throughout the house, so the system stops springing leaks.

services.title: Water Softeners
services.text: Softeners installed and repaired, so hard water stops leaving limescale behind.

services.title: Water Filtration
services.text: Reverse osmosis and carbon filtration systems for cleaner, better-tasting water.

services.title: Garbage Disposals
services.text: Disposals repaired or replaced when they jam, leak or stop turning.

services.title: Plumbing Inspections
services.text: A full look at the plumbing in the house, so problems turn up before the damage does.

crew.title: Rooted in the community we work in.
crew.text: We are not just another Pearland plumber. Our team has been part of this community since 2019, and we treat every home like our own, with meticulous workmanship and respectful service.

points.title: Licensed and insured
points.text: Every technician is licensed and trained, and the company is insured to protect your property.

points.title: Transparent pricing
points.text: You get the price up front, with no hidden fees or surprise costs at the end.

points.title: Warrantied work
points.text: Most services carry a warranty on both labor and parts.

reviews.author: Brenda Bugg
reviews.text: Eric and his helper arrived and cleared our drain quickly. They were courteous and knowledgeable. We have used Accurate Plumbing Services in the past and always receive excellent service at an affordable price.

reviews.author: Jeremy Kinn
reviews.text: I called Accurate Plumbing Services as a second opinion and I am extremely happy I did. The tech that came out, Eric, was friendly, professional, skilled and above all honest. The prices were reasonable and I would recommend giving them a call.

reviews.author: Shannon Tobias
reviews.text: Great service and they were very prompt, arriving right when they said they would. Prices were reasonable and they were super fast, respectful of my property and cleaned up after themselves.

facts.heading: 24/7 emergency service
facts.text: Emergency plumbing is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, holidays included. In most cases a licensed plumber can be at your door within 60 minutes of your call.

facts.heading: Free estimates
facts.text: Estimates are free with no obligation, and many standard services include a free diagnostic. You get a clear, written price before any work begins. Call (713) 817-3977 or request a free estimate online.

facts.heading: Typical prices
items: Drain clearing typically starts from $249, depending on the clog
Hydro jetting typically costs $300 to $600, quoted up front after a quick inspection

facts.heading: Licensed and insured
facts.text: Every technician holds a valid Texas plumbing license and is fully insured. We will show verification on request.

facts.heading: Warranties
facts.text: Most services carry a warranty on both labor and parts, and repiping is warrantied on materials and workmanship. Under our customer satisfaction guarantee, the job is not finished until you are satisfied.

facts.heading: Financing
facts.text: Interest-free financing through Synchrony is available for qualified customers, so larger repairs and installations can be paid over time.

facts.heading: Awards of Excellence
facts.text: Recognized with an Award of Excellence three years running: 2020, 2021 and 2022.

facts.heading: More of what we do
items: Water heater repair, replacement and maintenance for all makes and models, tank and tankless, gas and electric
Gas lines for outdoor kitchens, grills and fire pits, plus relocations, extensions, pressure testing and remodels
Partial and whole-house repiping in copper, PEX or CPVC
Slab leaks found with sonar and infrared equipment, repaired by epoxy lining, rerouting or spot excavation, with concrete and flooring restored
Video camera drain inspection, rooter service and storm drain maintenance
Grease trap cleaning for commercial kitchens
Leak detection, fixture installation and full kitchen and bathroom plumbing
